credentials.title: Accredited engineering degrees
credentials.desc: Both founders hold a completed BSc Eng (Hons) in Computer Engineering from the University of Ruhuna, Faculty of Engineering — a four-year degree from a UGC-recognised state university.

credentials.title: Specialised in exactly what we teach
credentials.desc: Our degree and professional work cover embedded systems, microcontrollers, robotics and machine learning — the same subjects your child learns, not a general IT background.

credentials.title: Real teaching experience
credentials.desc: We taught students and ran workshops before starting kidslab.lk. The curriculum is written and delivered by the same engineers who build with these technologies.

credentials.title: Publicly verifiable
credentials.desc: Our real names, photos and LinkedIn profiles are published here on purpose. Check our backgrounds yourself before you enrol — we would rather you did.

safety.subtitle: Online should not mean out of sight. Here is exactly how your child is supervised in every session.

cards.title: Live and supervised, always
cards.desc: Every class runs live on Zoom / Google Meet with cameras on and both instructors present for the full session. Children are never left in a room unattended.

cards.title: Parents are always welcome
cards.desc: You may sit in on any session at any time, without telling us in advance. Nothing in our classroom is closed to parents.

cards.title: Every session is recorded
cards.desc: Recordings are shared with parents, so you can review exactly what was taught and how your child was spoken to — even if you could not attend.

cards.title: Private, registered-only links
cards.desc: Class links are private and issued only to registered students. There are no public or open rooms, so strangers cannot join a class.

faq.subtitle: Everything parents ask us before enrolling if yours isn't here, reach out on WhatsApp.

items.a: kidslab.lk is Sri Lanka's Robotics & AI academy for children aged 9–14, conducted by Computer Engineers from the University of Ruhuna, Faculty of Engineering. All classes are held online, so kids from anywhere in Sri Lanka can join our office is based in Matara, Sri Lanka.

items.q: What age group is the Robotics & AI program for?
items.a: The program is designed for children aged 9 to 14 years old. Since classes are conducted online, kids from anywhere in Sri Lanka are welcome to join.

items.q: How much does the Robotics & AI program cost?
items.a: The course fee is LKR 5,000 for 3 months. It can be paid in installments within 3 months. Day 1 is a completely free introductory seminar with no obligation to continue.
The free introductory seminar is on 19 September 2026, conducted fully online. Seats are limited register at kidslab.lk/register.

items.q: What will my child learn in the Robotics & AI program?
items.a: Children learn to build real robots using mechanics, sensors, and microcontrollers. The program also covers Artificial Intelligence basics, machine learning concepts, and hands-on project building all in one 3-month course.

items.q: Who teaches the classes at kidslab.lk?
items.a: Classes are designed and taught by Viraj Samarasinghe and Menura Dulkith  Computer Engineering graduates from the University of Ruhuna, Faculty of Engineering, who specialize in AI & Robotics.

items.q: Are the instructors qualified to teach children?
items.a: Both instructors hold a completed BSc Eng (Hons) in Computer Engineering from the University of Ruhuna, Faculty of Engineering, and have taught students and run workshops before starting kidslab.lk. To be clear and honest: we are practising engineers who teach, not government-certified school teachers. The curriculum is written and delivered by the same people who build with robotics and AI professionally. Our real names, photos and LinkedIn profiles are published on this site so you can verify our backgrounds yourself before enrolling.

items.q: What exactly is in the syllabus?
items.a: The 3-month program moves week by week from electronics and circuit basics, to Arduino microcontroller programming, to sensors and actuators, to building a working robot, and then to an introduction to Artificial Intelligence and machine-learning concepts — finishing with a personal project your child builds and presents. We walk through the full week-by-week syllabus during the free seminar and send it in writing to every parent before the paid course begins. You can also request it any time on WhatsApp at +94703906478.

items.q: What equipment or robotics kit does my child need?
items.a: For the free seminar, nothing beyond a laptop or desktop with an internet connection. For the paid 3-month course we give you the exact kit list — microcontroller board, sensors, breadboard and jumper wires — along with where to buy it in Sri Lanka, before you pay anything. Early lessons also use free online circuit simulators, so your child can start on time even if the kit has not arrived yet.

items.q: How are children supervised during online classes?
items.a: Every class is live with cameras on and both instructors present for the entire session — children are never left in a room unattended. Class links are private and issued only to registered students, so no one outside the class can join. Parents are welcome to sit in on any session without telling us in advance, and every session is recorded and shared with parents so you can see exactly what was taught.

items.q: Where are the kidslab.lk classes held?
items.a: Classes are conducted entirely online, so your child can join from anywhere in Sri Lanka. Our office is located at 1/108, Pelawaththa Circle Road, Hittatiya Central, Matara.

Yes. kidslab.lk's office is located at 1/108, Pelawaththa Circle Road, Hittatiya Central, Matara, Sri Lanka. Since all classes are conducted online, children in Matara and across the rest of Sri Lanka can join equally.

items.q: Does kidslab.lk offer robotics and AI classes in Matara?
items.a: Yes. kidslab.lk is a Matara-based Robotics & AI academy for children aged 9–14. Classes are held online, so kids in Matara can join live sessions from home without needing to travel.

items.q: Can I pay the course fee in installments?
items.a: Yes. The LKR 5,000 course fee can be paid in installments spread over 3 months.

items.q: How do I register for the free seminar or the course?
items.a: Visit kidslab.lk/register and fill in your child's details. You can also contact us via WhatsApp at +94703906478.

items.q: Is kidslab.lk affiliated with the University of Ruhuna?
items.a: The programs are designed and conducted by Computer Engineering graduates and professionals from the University of Ruhuna, Faculty of Engineering.
